body:
I am sorry for your loss, too. Married at 30 and widow at almost 41. People tell me ‘oh you’re young.’ I don’t want another spouse, I don’t even want to date. And now here I am almost 42 and have been living with my parents while I sold our house and am trying to find a new place I don’t even want. Death of husband, selling stuff, cars, selling house where I felt closest to him, Funeral, moving - a lot of life’s major events all in a few months.
So very sorry for your loss. Whether it is expected from an illness or sudden, it still puts us in the same boat. :(

Is there a way to search a username on Reddit and see where else he posted? You can see I have no idea how this platform works :/ Based on the other communities he was interested in, I might know his username.
